lines.lyric_translation: The city of Seoul that shined exceptionally bright / Another world that I’m seeing for the first time

lines.lyric_hangul: 땀에 잔뜩 밴 채 만난 넌 뭔가 이상했었던 아이
lines.lyric_translation: You who I met while I was drenched in sweat / Were a somewhat strange kid

lines.lyric_translation: I’m on the moon, you’re on a star / Our conversations are like homeworks

lines.lyric_hangul: 하루는 베프, 하루는 웬수, I just wanna understand
lines.lyric_translation: Some days it’s our best friend, other days it’s our enemy / I just wanna understand

lines.lyric_translation: In this place forever, stay hey / Like your little pinky

lines.lyric_hangul: 일곱 번의 여름과 추운 겨울보다 오래
